scope: Public outcomes and bounded next questions. A queue entry is not an implemented result.
current_focus: Make the published research resources discoverable and usable, with working code/data links and explicit verification limits. New scientific implementations remain queued.

items.title: KI2002: pressure-dependent potential wells
items.outcome: Shared normalization at 0.9, 1 and 1.1 saturation pressure; code, configuration, CSV and independent checks. No compressible front speed is inferred.

items.title: Illustrative 2D thermal-condensation movie
items.outcome: Movie, initial/final states and numerical benchmarks. Enhanced conduction broadens interfaces; this is not a historical reproduction or sustained turbulence.

items.title: Kim & Kim2013: coupled Figure9 eigenfunctions
items.outcome: Source-audited specification only; no solver yet. Completion requires coupled components, one common amplitude/phase convention, boundary/domain convergence and an independent comparison.

items.title: Compressible flow versus reduced reaction–diffusion models
items.outcome: Explain pressure, momentum, advection and compressional work using existing equations. Nearly uniform pressure does not imply zero flow. A new simulation is a separate task.

items.title: Iwasaki2012: one missing branch or critical-flux example
items.outcome: Choose one bounded trajectory diagnostic and preserve the nine existing classifications. A full map recomputation is not required.

items.title: Schwarz1972: timing and mesh sensitivity
items.outcome: Reuse existing resolution studies and separate source-reading, model and discretization uncertainties. Continuum convergence of the narrow conductive layer is not established.

items.title: FGH1969: historical coefficient recovery
items.outcome: Restart only with a recoverable historical rate/cross-section, a checkable convention explaining a residual, or equivalent new evidence. Do not tune rates to force the original curve.
